Endstop check
Drives the flap onto both stops and reports what the hall sensor read at each one. Nothing is stored; this answers "is the sensor seeing the magnet".
    The strip
    • Lights on
      The master switch for both strips
    • Override on a hot chamber
      Show the warning colours above the hot threshold
    • Follow the printer
      Show a different effect for each printer state
    • Follow the vent
      Use the open or closed colour depending on the flap
    • Run backwards
      Reverse every effect on both strips
    The effect
    Simple uses one effect all the time. Per printer state gives each of the six states its own. Hot chamber has two: safe, and over the threshold.

    LED strips
    How many LEDs each strip really has. Effects with a centre, and the progress bar, need these to land in the right place.
    • Strip 1
      Mounted backwards
    • Strip 2
      Mounted backwards
    Behaviour
    The factory firmware calls 50 °C hot and cannot be told otherwise. That suits PLA and not ABS, where the bed sits at a hundred all print.
    • Join the strips
      Treat both as one long run, so effects sweep end to end
    • My own error flash
      The factory setting is a steady red
    Error colour
    Brightness 100%
    Strobe
    Your own animation
    Each row of the image becomes one frame across the strip. Held in memory, so it is gone after a restart.
    • Loaded
      Nothing
    • Room for
      170 frames
    The vent's own button light
    • Auto
      Factory behaviour: dark in Auto, blinking in manual
    • Always on
      Lit at all times
    • Always off
      Dark at all times
    • On when open
      Lit whenever the vent is open, factory behaviour when closed
    • Off when closed
      Dark whenever the vent is closed, factory behaviour when open
    • Blink
      Pulse rather than sit steady
    Vent policy
    The factory firmware opens the vent during every print. ABS and its relatives want the chamber sealed, and the printer says which filament is loaded, so the vent can decide for itself.
    • Material aware
      Seal or vent depending on what is loaded
    • Loaded filament
      PLA
    Filament rules
    • Hold open while hot
      Do not close a chamber that is still hot from the last print

    Power
    A factory reset erases the Wi-Fi credentials, the printer binding and every light setting. It cannot be undone from here.
    Bind to a printer
    The vent finds Bambu printers on the same network. Pick yours and it fills in the serial; the access code is on the printer's own screen.

    Live stream
    RTSP is turned off on the printer. Turn it on from the printer's own screen, under the camera settings, and the address will appear here.
    rtsps://bblp:••••@192.0.2.65:322/streaming/live/1

    Host name
    A name is easier to remember than an address and survives the router handing out a different one.
    Adding .local to this name reaches the vent from any device on the network.
    The vent's own network
    Connect to this from a phone or laptop when the vent is not on your Wi-Fi, then open the address below.
    • Hotspot on
      Always on, so you can always reach the vent. Changing the name, the password or this switch drops you if you are connected through it.
    Leave this alone unless it clashes with something on your network.
